reviews.text:
The care, availability, treatment, and professionalism of the team at the Borrell Clinic are unparalleled.

From the first time we took our puppy there a year ago, we always left with the confidence that she had received the best possible care.

If we were to move to a different neighborhood, we are certain that we would continue taking Molecola to the Borrell Clinic.

We are delighted and have been very lucky to find such attentive people and professionals who care for both you and your dog.

We recommend them wholeheartedly.

Excellent professionals and great human beings, who treat animals as if they were their own...
Total empathy for any problem.
Totally recommended as a Veterinary Center so you can put your pet in their hands.
They treat my dog ​​with so much love and care! Highly recommended, very professional and friendly service.

Our favorite vet in Barcelona! Everyone here is super nice, and helpful. Our vet, Esther, is amazing and meticulous with her work. We had a lot of issues about traveling with our cats this summer and Esther went out of her way to help us through it. She checked in with us every day. I don't know what we would have done without her. Wholeheartedly recommended!

A wonderful experience. From the very first moment, both the veterinarian Esther and the assistants treated us with great kindness and professionalism. It's clear they truly care for the animals and work with a lot of love.

They also have a very well-stocked shop, with all sorts of items and products for our furry friends. 🐾❤️

We will definitely be back. Highly recommended!
All the staff are very friendly and professional, and the clinic is always in excellent condition. Nuria, my dog's vet, clearly loves her job and is always very dedicated. A 10 out of 10!
Yolanda's treatment and effectiveness have been excellent!! 🥰
They are very professional and very kind. They are not at all financially motivated, and I am very happy.

Whenever I have had to take my dogs there, they have treated us very well, with great attention and professionalism. In addition, they don't usually make us wait long and that is very appreciated. Highly recommended! 🐾 …
Very happy with all the veterinarians, very attentive and professional!!

Excellent experience! They helped me with the entire process of getting my dog's European passport and were incredibly kind and helpful throughout. The front desk staff were lovely, always willing to help and answer any questions. They also pampered my dog ​​and treated her with so much love, which is super important to me. 🤍

I left very happy with the service and would definitely return. Thank you so much for everything!

Karen and Kira 🐶

I honestly cannot recommend this clinic enough. ❤️

It is so clear that the people working here genuinely care about animals - not just as patients, but as little lives that deserve kindness, patience and respect.

I have personally seen how much attention and love is given to every animal, and especially how caring and dedicated Yolanda is. She has such a beautiful way with animals, and you can truly feel that this is more than just a job for her. She notices the little things, takes her time, and treats every animal with such genuine compassion.

It is incredibly reassuring to know that places like this exist, with people who care so deeply about the animals they look after. If you are looking for a veterinary clinic where your beloved pet will be treated by kind, attentive and truly compassionate humans, this is absolutely the place to go.

Thank you for taking such good care of our animals and for putting so much heart into what you do. 🐾❤️
Excellent clinic with professional and competent staff. Highly recommended.
Very welcoming and caring specialists. They patiently address all questions and concerns, I feel my cats are safe with them.

Excellent service and friendly treatment.
The staff is attentive and professional.
From the very first moment, they demonstrated great professionalism, a friendly approach, and above all, enormous care and respect for my pet. Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic.

Our beloved companions, Quetzalcoat and Llum (two wonderful cats), are cared for by the amazing professionals at this clinic.
These professionals, with their unparalleled empathy and compassion, look after what we love most and are there for us when our kittens' health needs monitoring, both during routine checkups and preventative care.
The respect and care shown to Llum and Quetzalcoat gives us peace of mind and comfort; we would never go to another clinic.
Thank you so much, Borrell Veterinary Clinic team.
Professionalism and unbeatable service.

From the first day, I have felt very well taken care of, assistants, administrators, veterinarians, etc. are all so loving with the pets, very attentive, and they give you all kinds of explanations, recommendations at all levels: health, hygiene, food, buying accessories... I 100% recommend the center.
My pet's experience at the vet has completely changed. He and Nuria get along incredibly well; Nuria takes care of my Rufito as if he were her own. I couldn't be happier with them.
I've been to several vets with my dog, and this is undoubtedly the one where he's received the best care and where they've truly looked after him. All the staff are excellent.
Clean place, professional and friendly staff 😊
They are our trusted veterinarians in Barcelona, ​​and they are wonderful with our dog! Esther always treats us very well, thank you so much!
My daughter had an urgent problem with her dog 🐕 and they went out of their way to help her with such kindness.... Thank you to the whole team 👏👏👏👏👏

I'm delighted with Borrel Veterinary Clinic. The service has been excellent from the very first moment, both for us and our pet. Their professionalism, experience, and above all, the care they give to the animals is truly remarkable.

They explain everything very clearly, answer any questions, and inspire a great sense of calm and confidence. Furthermore, the staff is incredibly kind, attentive, and approachable.

Without a doubt, this veterinary clinic is highly recommended. It's incredibly reassuring to know your pet is in such good hands. Many thanks to the entire team!

My kitten just had surgery and received exceptional care and pampering. The kindness and reassurance from the very first moment quickly translated into trust. They addressed my concerns about the surgery and recovery with excellent feedback. Thank you 😘
Always kind, people who make careful decisions and look out for the well-being of their pets. Animal lovers and a solid team of professionals.

Since moving to Barcelona, ​​Borrell Veterinary Clinic has become a place we and our cats, Lily and Mushu, trust completely.

The service is always attentive and friendly, and their professionalism is evident in every visit. They explain things clearly, take all the time you need, and you never leave the consultation with any questions. Something we really appreciate is the follow-up care, because they always make sure everything is going well after the visit, and that speaks volumes about their work.

But what truly makes the difference is the care they show to every pet that walks through the door. Our two cats are calm and comfortable whenever we've had to take them there, and anyone who has cats knows that says a lot.

Thank you so much for everything. We recommend them without hesitation.
I haven't been going for very long, but in the time I have, they've been very effective and efficient, from communication to professionalism. Thank you very much.

Excellent in every way.
We received excellent service. The veterinary clinic is very clean, well laid out, well-air-conditioned, and quite spacious.

All the staff are very professional, especially Nuria, who is a wonderful woman and very good at her job. 10/10

I love the girls who work there; they're always available and give advice on anything!
The doctor whose name I can't remember is a sweetheart! I live in the area, and when I go by with my dog, it's always a problem 😩😩😩 I have to drag him because he wants to come in and say hello 😄😄😄 That says it all!

I would like to thank the great attention we have always received at the Borrell Veterinary Clinic. Nico has always been treated with great professionalism, love and dedication. From the first day they have been able to treat his anxiety with great patience and sensitivity, making each visit much more peaceful for him and for us.

The sterilization procedure went perfectly, and both the follow-up and all subsequent check-ups have been excellent. Nico has always been very well looked after and we have felt accompanied at all times.

We would like to make a special mention to his veterinarian, Esther Moliner, for her professionalism, her closeness and the affection with which she always treats Nico. We would also like to highlight the kindness and good attention of the reception team, who always greet us with a smile and help us with everything we need.

It is a veterinary center of total trust that we recommend without a doubt. Thank you very much for taking such good care of our Nico!

Post from two years ago:
Simba and Kovu have been going here ever since, visits to the vet have been pure joy! Seeing them go and how calm they are when they leave is such a delight! All the vets, assistants, and administrative staff are wonderful people. Happy holidays!

Today, July 13, 2026: They are the best team of people, through thick and thin. Even in the toughest moments, they go above and beyond their job descriptions, transcending those moments every single day. We've experienced countless good times and two tragic ones. And in those tragic moments, they proved what we already knew: they are wonderful people and a truly dedicated veterinary team.

There hasn't been a better place to go through everything we've been through and to say goodbye to our little ones, Kovu and Simba.

Anyone who says a bad word about these people clearly doesn't know them.

A million thanks to the entire team at Clinica Borrell for taking such good care of our little ones ❤️
My dog ​​and I are very happy with the attention and professionalism of the Borrell veterinary center. Thank you.

Her veterinarian was always on vacation at critical times. When I had to request euthanasia, she was also away. The veterinarian on duty attended to us. She told me that she did not know the animal and that she would call the dog's veterinarian, she confirmed that we were proceeding with euthanasia, I asked her for alternatives and she told me that there were none, so I understood that there was no other way than the one I also saw. Days later, my regular veterinarian called me and told me that she had authorized it because if I could see it clearly, she knew that I knew the animal perfectly (she washed her hands: it seems that I paid for a veterinary criterion that was not necessary). I had been having doubts for a long time about why I was paying for the consultations, but then it became completely clear to me, because I attribute value to studies and professional licenses that they often do not have. I had thought about letting it go, but it seems like a betrayal of Iris's memory and suffering to say nothing and also a betrayal of other innocent animals and dedicated and faithful guardians.

After many years of trusting this clinic, both with my dog ​​Mel and other dogs in my family, I can say without a doubt that it is an extraordinary clinic.

A year ago, Mel underwent surgery for a malignant tumor and subsequently had to undergo chemotherapy. Due to her pre-existing conditions, not just any treatment was suitable for her. The veterinarian and oncologist Esther studied her case with meticulous care and designed a chemotherapy regimen specifically tailored to her needs. Her professionalism, knowledge, and dedication made a tremendous difference in her treatment.

I want to give special recognition to her (although I will speak later about the entire exceptional team). Finding professionals with such a high level of expertise is already difficult, but finding people who also practice their profession with so much love, empathy, and sensitivity towards animals and their families is truly exceptional. During the most difficult times, I felt supported, listened to, and understood. We were never just a number; we always felt that Mel was important to them.

I also want to sincerely thank the entire team of assistants and veterinarians. From the moment you walk through the door, you can feel their dedication. They treat each animal with immense love and their families with a warmth and compassion that offer comfort when you need it most.

After so many years of going to this clinic, I can say that I have absolutely nothing negative to say. Only words of gratitude and admiration.

Thank you for taking such good care of Mel, for your kindness and your professional excellence. I wish all veterinary clinics had a team like yours. We will always be deeply grateful. ❤️ Thanks to everyone, Mel is still doing well and is with us. 🙏❤️‍🩹😘
With much love.
Thank you so much for your review! We sincerely appreciate your trust and those 5 stars. We hope to continue taking care of you and Emma and Frida whenever you need us!

Incompetent! They sold me an expensive product, telling me the brand would refund my money if it didn't work properly. After less than 5 hours, I returned with the receipt and the product, and they haven't refunded me anything! Liars! Incompetent and cheats! I'll never be back!
Very good professionals

I’ve been coming to this clinic for years with my very high-maintenance Shih Tzu, who has a long list of health issues and requires visits far more often than I’d like. Through every appointment, ultrasound, x-ray, and vaccination, the team has been consistently kind, compassionate, and very knowledgeable.

They take superb care of him, and it’s obvious how much they genuinely care about their patients. My dog is completely comfortable with them, which gives me peace of mind. They’ve also been a huge source of support for me, taking the time to explain things clearly, offer practical, thoughtful advice, and help me make informed decisions while being mindful of costs whenever possible. They always recommend what’s genuinely best for my dog.

I’m so grateful to have found Clinica Borrell. I honestly can’t imagine my dog’s journey without them, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for exceptional vet care.

This place is wonderful; they've treated my dog ​​Donna exceptionally well. Everyone there is so kind and professional, especially our dear Ester, who has truly been a blessing for my dog.
We couldn't have been in better hands.
I'm so grateful to have found such a lovely and wonderful place for her!
Thank you so much!

The best place my four-legged boy has ever been cared for 🐶 A million thanks to all the staff members. They are wonderful professionals with so much empathy and dedication. Much love from Benito and family. 💖 …

I've been coming to this veterinary clinic for my dog ​​Cayetana for a while now, and I couldn't be happier. From day one, the service has been exceptional: they always treat her with so much love, patience, and care, which gives me enormous peace of mind.
The whole team is incredibly friendly and approachable, yet highly professional.
They explain everything clearly, offer honest advice, and take care of even the smallest detail. It's one of those places where you feel you're in good hands from the very first moment.
Without a doubt, it's a completely trustworthy place where I'll continue to take Cayetana. 100% recommended!

We love this clinic! Our vet Esther is a wonderful specialist. We've been taking our two Peruvian dogs to her for a long time, we're very happy with this place and we have no intention of changing! 👍❤️ …

This place is terrible because they constantly reschedule appointments. My cat was very sick, and this clinic is closer to us, so we tried to make an appointment, but they rescheduled our appointment three times, and my cat died because of it. Honestly, I forgot about it and made an appointment for vaccinations for another cat, and of course, they rescheduled it again. I'm shocked. Please go to another clinic.
They'll treat the animals very well.
They are kind and lovely. I'm so glad to have trusted specialists close to home. Excellent service from Esther and the rest of the staff.
Excellent service from veterinarian Esther and the staff at the shop. Appointment reminders were very timely.

This vet was recommended to me because I'd been looking for a good one for Bella for years. I can only thank the whole team for their wonderful treatment and kindness.

Bella is thrilled with the reception staff and with Esther. Thank you so much for being who you are and for taking such good care of our pets.

Now Bella even has some favorite treats!

I go to that vet and I live in Tarragona, but I wouldn't change my vet for anything in the world. I met the colleague who works at reception and she's a sweetheart, so besides going back for Nuria, I'd also go back for her colleague. They took care of Casper as if he were their own. I'll be back a thousand times.

Excellent professionals, friendly and attentive. They also have well-maintained and well-equipped facilities.
Nuria is a delight; she's been taking Ninu to us since she was a puppy, and it's a pleasure to work with her.
Thank you for the 5 stars! ⭐️💙 We're so grateful for your trust. See you next time! …

Love for animals
And effectiveness

At home, we're delighted with how the clinic treats our dog. He goes into the clinic without any hesitation, and that's very important to us.
If he's okay, we're okay.
Excellent service at Borrell Veterinary Clinic. Very professional, attentive, and caring with pets. They explain everything clearly and inspire a lot of confidence. Highly recommended!

Very happy with the attention received! They have accompanied us throughout the entire process with Bruna with great professionalism and proximity😊

In addition, whenever she passes by the clinic she wants to stop and say hello — she loves the team! Totally recommended!

I took my dog ​​Pepa and it was great. They were very kind, checked her thoroughly, and gave her all the space she needed. They tested her for Leishmaniasis and gave me the receipt super fast. Highly recommended!
Thank you so much for those 5 stars! We really appreciate your trust and support.

I discovered this vet when I moved to Barcelona and we've been going for six years. Our babies feel safe and cared for during their visits. And we have peace of mind knowing they're in good hands. Ester is amazing!
I adopted a kitten and started taking her there for all her checkups and vaccinations. So far, everything's been great. They have some good packages for saving money, which is a good idea.

Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic in Barcelona. Jordi, the vet, and all the staff are excellent professionals. They're very clear with you and always attentive to your pet.

Highly recommended.
Fast and efficient

Excellent professionals. From the very first minute, they've been incredibly attentive and caring with all my animals (2 cats and 1 dog). Esther is a true professional and animal lover who's been absolutely wonderful with my older cat. Thank you so much, team!

It is a very nice place. It gives me security and confidence both to my dog ​​Nelson and to us. All the staff is kind and patient.
Esther Moliner has been Nelson's vet since he was a puppy and I have no words to describe the peace of mind she gives us after each visit.
Thank you very much for being so attentive and concerned about the health of our dog.

I also think this is the best veterinary clinic in Barcelona. At first glance, you can see it's a spacious, bright, clean, tidy, and beautiful place... But what's truly important is the fantastic team of people who radiate such positive energy. The assistants are lovely, as are the veterinarians, who are super professional and the best hands to leave our beloved companions in when we want them to receive the best possible care and treatment. 200% recommended!! 💞💞💞
Good, trustworthy clinic
Thank you for the 5 stars! We are so happy to have your trust and that of your cat Luna.
Excellent service and wonderful treatment of my little Cavalier. Their professionalism and care are evident; they always give him a treat, which makes him happy and fearless when he arrives home. 😊 …

The most highly recommended veterinary clinic in Barcelona. I can't thank them enough for the care we received at this clinic. I have two very special cats, a Maine Coon and a Persian kitten, and I'd always struggled to find a place that truly understood the specific needs of their breeds.
From the very first moment, you realize this isn't just another clinic; it's a place where they love what they do. Their professionalism is impeccable, but what truly sets them apart is the empathy and gentleness with which they treat my little ones. It's clear they have extensive knowledge; they explain everything in detail and give me a priceless sense of peace.
Seeing my cats calm and in the best hands fills me with tranquility. If you're looking for a team that combines expertise with a huge heart, this is the place. Thank you for taking such loving care of my feline family!

The best place I could have found to care for my Trufita. All the staff, starting with her doctor Esther, have always been so loving and kind, and they've explained everything so well. They've also helped me with her passport and travel permits, always quickly and easily. It's impossible to walk past without my little dog standing at the door wanting to come in! 🙃😍
Thank you for choosing us and for being part of our little family of furry friends.

The vet who treated us was excellent. No complaints about her or the clinic. I'm sorry to say, but the receptionist is rude. We haven't had any problems with her because we've been in the waiting room, but she speaks to everyone in a condescending manner. While I was in the waiting room, I observed how everyone was working, and she was very rude. Her responses are curt and unpleasant. She's not suited to face the public. 70% of clinics that close in Spain do so because the client didn't feel well treated, and this girl was truly awful. I hope they put someone more polite at reception, or at least someone with more charisma. I'm not saying she should flatter everyone, but a little cordiality would be nice, so people don't feel like they're asking for a favor.

That's my only complaint about this place. Otherwise, it's very good.

My cat Soya has been coming to the clinic for over a year now, and the vet, Jordi, has always been amazing to us. His kindness, friendliness, and professionalism make every visit so much easier. He's truly one of the best vets we've ever met! 💜🐾 …
